TREMAINE TEDDY REESE.name: Teddy Reese
TREMAINE TEDDY REESE.background: Tremaine "Teddy" Reese, Democrat from Columbus; born and raised in Gordon, Georgia, by a single mother who worked as a janitor at his high school; first in his family to earn a college degree. B.S. in computer science, Albany State University (2003); M.P.A., Georgia College & State University (2005); J.D., Florida A&M University College of Law (2012). Staff attorney and director of community engagement at Georgia Appleseed Center for Law & Justice (2013-2017), senior attorney at The Wright Legal Group (2017-2018), now principal owner and managing attorney of The Reese Firm, LLC. Former national chair of the ABA Law Student Division. Lost a 2016 at-large Columbus City Council race and the June 9, 2020 Democratic primary for State Senate District 15 to Sen. Ed Harbison (46.9%). Elected to the Georgia House, District 140, in 2022 (succeeding Calvin Smyre), re-elected 2024; serving since Jan. 9, 2023. Won the May 19, 2026 Democratic primary for the open Senate District 15 seat (58.8%) and faced Republican Chuck Hand on Nov. 3, 2026.
